earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE Exhibit 99.1
highlights: Net earnings per diluted share as reported (EPS) were $12.29, compared with $10.57 in the prior-year period.
Adjusted EPS was $12.57, an increase of 13% over the prior-year amount of $11.15.
EPS in the quarter was $12.29, compared with the prior-year amount of $10.57.
Reported and local currency sales increased 6% compared with the prior year.
Compared with the prior year, total reported sales increased 6% to $1.094 billion.

quotes.text: We delivered an excellent third quarter, achieving relatively broad-based growth across our portfolio while capitalizing on improving market demand. Performance was particularly strong in Asia / Rest of World.

outlook: Based on today's assessment, management anticipates local currency sales for the fourth quarter of 2026 will increase approximately 5%.
Adjusted EPS is forecast to be $14.84 to $15.04, a growth rate of 11% to 13%.
For the full year 2026, management anticipates local currency sales will increase approximately 5%, which excludes the impact of tariff refunds to customers.
Adjusted EPS is forecast to be in the range of $47.70 to $47.90, representing growth of approximately 12%.

items.heading: We sell primarily to companies in developed countries. An economic downturn in these countries could hurt our operating results.
We are subject to risks associated with our international operations, including our significant concentration of business in China.
Our business and financial performance may be adversely affected by a cybersecurity attack.
We are vulnerable to system failures and data loss risks, which could harm our business.
Our ability to manufacture and deliver products and services may be disrupted.
Our business would suffer if we were unable to obtain supplies of material.
